name: The View From The Beach
source:
Go to the beach with Hawk and JJ!

This gay erotic visual novel is a standalone continuation of the [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.com/hawkxjj.html]Hawk and JJ[/url]] series. In this story, two boyfriends go to the beach and have a little fun together.

[From [url=https://wannabeyourdog2.itch.io/the-view-from-the-beach]Itch.io[/url]]

和霍克与JJ一起去海滩度假吧！
